name: refuse-tangent-blend
why: A blend whose ends land on faces the boss is tangent to. OCCT reports IsDone() == true and hands back an unorientable B-spline patch and a self-intersecting wire; at this size the wreckage also breaches the part's bounding box, so the containment post-condition is what refuses it. Pairs with refuse-tangent-blend-in-bounds, where it does not and only the validity check fires, and with blend-runs-off-the-edge, which proves the refusal is about tangency and not about the fillet reaching the plate's side.
